issues.quote: `/shop/` has its own title, description and unique content … but its canonical tag names `/coffee/`.
`/coffee/` and `/subscriptions/` both use "Single-Origin Indonesian Coffee | Kopi Kita".
The Kintamani title is very long (about 80 characters) … It will be cut off in results.
`/blog/how-to-brew-pour-over/` (recommends "our Aceh Gayo" with no link and no product page).
Flores Bajawa is in the sitemap but only reachable through the sitemap itself, which makes it close to an orphan page.
`/coffee/brewing-guide/` has "Coffee brewing guide" and "Brew methods" both as H1.
about 1.8 MB, displayed at 2400 by 1600 pixels. This is likely to slow page load
Bali Kintamani's Product markup has no `name` field.
`/coffee/`: FAQPage markup is present. Google now shows FAQ rich results only for a small set of sites, so do not expect visible gains.
Title "Best Coffee Beans in Bali (2024 Guide)", H1 "(2024 guide)"

wrong_findings.claim: The Aceh Gayo mention in the pour-over post has no link.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The post links “Aceh Gayo” to `/coffee/aceh-gayo/`; the crawl shows that URL returns 404.

wrong_findings.claim: Every live page has a unique, descriptive H1.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The crawl shows `/visit/` has no H1 and `/coffee/brewing-guide/` has two.

wrong_findings.claim: Every live page has a title in the right format.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The crawl shows an 88-character title on `/coffee/bali-kintamani/`, and `/coffee/` shares its title with `/subscriptions/`.

wrong_findings.claim: Google now shows FAQ rich results for a small set of sites.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The stated grading context says Google stopped showing FAQ rich results in May 2026.

extra_true.finding: `/coffee/flores-bajawa/` has no Product markup despite listing a price.
The pages lack Open Graph and Twitter Card tags, as claimed in the audit.
The home page body does not link to `/subscriptions/`, `/shop/` or `/visit/`.
The audit identifies missing `image`, `mainEntityOfPage`, and author `url` fields in blog Article markup.
The audit identifies no BreadcrumbList markup.
The local server returns a default error page for missing URLs, as described in the audit.

notes: Issue 7 is scored 0 because the audit says the product mention is unlinked, while the actual problem is a linked URL returning 404. Issue 18 gets half credit for identifying the FAQ markup on `/coffee/` without identifying the missing visible FAQ content.
